title: REQ · HeaderOverlay shows logo, world name, round ID, status and countdown
summary: HeaderOverlay renders identity and round info from worldTitle and round props
description: Context: round data is a Round from api/client.ts (id, number, status, starts_at, ends_at). Desired behavior: with a round supplied, the header shows the StoryForge logo, worldTitle, round.id, round.status and a Countdown to round.ends_at. Expected result: all five items present in one compact bar. Why: players must see which round is live and when it ends.
acceptance_criteria: Given worldTitle 'The Boy's Room' and a round, When rendered, Then the text 'StoryForge', the world title, round.id and round.status are in the document
Given a round with a future ends_at, When rendered, Then a role=timer element is present

in_scope: Logo, world name, round ID, status, countdown rendering
